title: Ministers Perform An EXORCISM On Chrisean Rock! (WATCH)
excerpt: Ministers Perform An EXORCISM On Chrisean Rock! (WATCH)
content:
EXCLUSIVE: CHRISEAN ROCK UNDERGOES MAKESHIFT EXORCISM TO BREAK DEMONIC SOUL TIE WITH BLUEFACE!! Ministers Hold Her Down In Intense Deliverance Session… Says She Felt Demonic Presence Leave Her Body!! (DETAILS)

Just when you thought the wild, unpredictable saga of Chrisean Rock and Blueface couldn’t get any more intense, the reality star and gospel singer just took her spiritual journey to an absolute extreme!

Media Take Out learned that after Blueface officially dumped her yet again following a weekend of chaotic public arguments, Chrisean decided enough was enough. Realizing she needed supernatural intervention to break what she described as a toxic “demonic soul tie,” she called multiple pastors and deliverance ministers to her residence for an intense, makeshift exorcism session!

INSIDE THE INTENSE DELIVERANCE: PASTORS HOLD HER DOWN

Footage and eyewitness reports circulating across social media describe a scene straight out of a spiritual warfare movie as ministers prayed over the emotional star:

  • Held Down On The Floor: Witnesses reveal that as the pastors laid hands on Chrisean, she began shaking and weeping intensely. Multiple ministers reportedly had to hold her down as they commanded toxic entities and “demons of attachment” to leave her spirit!
  • Feeling The Release: Following the agonizing session, Chrisean took to live stream to share her testimony, explaining that she physically felt “something heavy” detach and leave her body during the intense prayers.
  • Rededicating Her Life To Christ: Chrisean proclaimed that she has completely surrendered her heart and life back to Jesus, declaring that the hold Blueface had over her mind, spirit, and emotions is officially BROKEN for good!

INTERNET REACTS TO THE MAKESHIFT EXORCISM

As clips of the deliverance session and Chrisean’s emotional testimony went viral across X, TikTok, and Instagram, fans and commentators immediately flooded comment sections with mixed reactions:

  • Praying For Genuine Healing: Dedicated supporters rallied behind the “Yahweh” singer, praying that this spiritual milestone finally gives her the strength to permanently walk away from the toxic back-and-forth cycle.
  • Skeptics Calling It A Show: On the flip side, critics pointed out that Chrisean has gone to church and proclaimed her faith multiple times before—only to run back to Blueface hours later—begging her to back up her deliverance with real boundaries!

“Chrisean literally had pastors holding her down on the floor to pray the Blueface demons off of her?! If you need a whole TEAM of ministers to cast out a man’s spirit from your body, that is the ultimate sign to stay away from him forever!” — Social Media Commentator

What do you think about Chrisean Rock undergoing an exorcism and deliverance session to get over Blueface? Do you think she is finally done with him for good this time?! Drop your thoughts and prayers in the comment section below!
